title: Dweet Fish: Stay a While
about: A fish made of tiny code that unpacks itself, one step at a time, then faints when its counter overflows. Then it wakes up and starts again. Leave it open. It is slow on purpose, and so am I.

constraint.text: Make it for someone who will stay a long time.
